_help: The cars. 'model' is a car from the library (cars/<id>: web/cars/README.md lists them), one of the kit's in web/racing/models (without .glb), or models/<name> for one of this game's own (it needs four wheel parts named wheel-front-left, wheel-front-right, wheel-back-left and wheel-back-right). 'length' is its length in metres. The rest are compared with a Stocker in Stock Cars: 'top' speed, 'accel', 'grip' (open-wheelers corner on downforce) and 'weight'.

cars.name: Single-seater
cars.about: Light, quick and planted in the corners. Fragile: the barriers are not your friend.
